verdict: **Reliable down to a clip floor**: detection holds above the 80% bar only while clip_ratio stays at or above **0.25** (clamping to 25% of peak); below that, saturation distortion drops accuracy to 50% at clip_ratio 0.1. Loud or close-talking capture that flat-tops harder than this will be missed — add input headroom / anti-clip limiting, or train with clipped augmentation to widen tolerance.
